name: Kisvelt Bullancie
original_name: キスヴェルト・ブランシェ
source:
Liphia's older brother. He is a nice young man who is soft spoken and always smiles, but he is a serious siscon.

Because he tries to exterminate any "insects" that come near his sister, he is somewhat hostile to Deycas.

[Translated from [url=http://fleur0.starfree.jp/chara.html]official website[/url]]

Flower Emblem: Rose
Ability: Rough Rose
